findings.title: The concurrent reader is neither coordinated nor joined before asserting
findings.body: The test starts a background reader and immediately deletes the groups, sets the stop flag, and asserts the exception list without waiting for the reader to begin or terminate. The reader can therefore be scheduled only after `deletedAll` is true (performing no request at all), or it can record an exception after the assertion has already passed. It can also continue issuing a request after the test has returned. This makes the regression test capable of passing without exercising the delete/read race. Coordinate a reader request with the delete operation and stop/join the thread (preferably in a finally block) before checking `caughtExceptions`.
